name: DexScreener

notes: Falcon: the single evenodd path of the white (#fff) logo served inline in the header of marketplace.dexscreener.com (viewBox 0 0 210 240). No DEX Screener brand kit was found; dexscreener.com is behind a bot challenge and its app icons are raster only.

Default: the official app icon's composition, built from that vector: the falcon at 80% of the height, centred on a full-bleed #09090B square (colour and placement measured from icon-512x512.png; nothing traced). The mark is only ever presented on black, so the base keeps the container (docs/icon-variants.md, base icon background rule).
Mono: the square with the falcon knocked out (evenodd). SymbolMono: the falcon alone in currentColor.
